title Varo - the boss battle (optional, for the villains' leaders): menacing E phrygian at 160 bpm, a pounding kick and snare under a chromatic bass riff, brassy stabs that lean on the half step, a tritone, a power-chord anthem, a chromatic climb and a snare roll
tempo 160
vol 205
meter 4/4
inst bass v=255,200,160
inst brass v=255,255,230,205,190
inst lead v=255,255,225,195,180
inst pow arp=-12,0,7 rate=1 lvl=0.9
inst kick drum=g5 v=255,200,140 d=0,-45,-75
inst snr drum=a6 noise=25 seed=9 fall=12
l8
# --- 1-2: the riff (E, F, E, G, F, E, D sharp, E)
@bass o3 [ !kick:e e !snr:f e ]2 |
@bass o3 !kick:e e !snr:g f !kick:e e !snr:d+ e |
# --- 3-4: brass stabs on the half step
@brass o4 !kick:e4 !snr:e8 e8 !kick:f4 !snr:e4 |
@brass o4 !kick:g4 !snr:f4 !kick:e4 !snr:d+4 |
# --- 5-6: the tritone (E against B flat)
@lead o5 !kick:e b- !snr:e b- !kick:e b- !snr:f4 |
@lead o5 !kick:b- e !snr:b- e !kick:b- e !snr:f4 |
# --- 7-8: the anthem in power chords
@pow o4 !kick:e2 !snr:f2 |
@pow o4 !kick:g2 f4 e4 |
# --- 9-10: the chromatic climb
@lead o4 e f f+ g g+ a b- b |
@lead o5 c c+ d d+ e f f+ g |
# --- 11: the snare roll into the loop
[ !snr=9 ]8 [ !snr=5 ]12 !kick=18
